problem: SU and synchronous native commands read WEXITSTATUS without first checking whether the child exited normally. A signal-killed child could be reported as success; an interrupted C++ wait could also read an uninitialized status.

fork_source_control.method: Execute the unchanged production SU wait block against a real forked child killed by SIGKILL.

changes: Distinguish normal exit from signal termination and return 128 plus the terminating signal.
Retry waitpid on EINTR and preserve errors without reading an unwritten status.
Wait through nonterminal child states rather than reporting completion.

cases: interrupted wait followed by child exit 7

passed: BlueStacks Air Android 13 debug host bootstrap
Owned BlueStacks clone across two boots

probe_correction: The BusyBox probe must read the command status in a continuing shell; the old SU wait bug can mask a directly exec-ed crash. No zero status alone is accepted as proof that this module works.
